privacyGate.meaning: Bind-value-on-error suppression does not suppress server DETAIL/HINT/CONTEXT fields or redact credential/verifier literals in logged DDL. privacyGate.implemented: Actual bound connection checks effective metadata before any private query and fails closed unless error DETAIL and private statement/bind capture are excluded. It does not SET/ALTER logging, grant privileges or disable provider logs.
privacyGate.notAssumed: No actual credential, verifier or private-row leak was induced or observed. No synthetic secret was sent to hosted SQL. Unsafe capture follows documented effective settings; the tested guard rejects those settings.
privacyGate.scopeBoundary: No environment/logging downgrade, new parameter SET grant, global logging change, managed Auth change or immutable migration rewrite performed. A supported authorized per-service privacy/redaction disposition is required before provisioning and activation.
